run_dl3dv_conversion: run the dl3dv conversion script to convert DL3DV dataset scenes to WAI processing format
convert_scene_dl3dv: convert a single DL3DV scene by transforming OpenGL poses to OpenCV and creating symlinks for images
get_original_scene_names_dl3dv: get all original scene names from DL3DV dataset splits ranging from 1K to 11K
review_convert_scene: review the convert_scene function that processes DL3DV scenes with transforms.json, colmap, and images
summarize_dl3dv_conversion: summarize the dl3dv conversion pipeline that transforms scene data and camera poses for WAI processing
